_readme: Source of truth for the house layout. DRAFT v1, drawn from Andrew's walkthrough + listing photos. Andrew will correct it.
Units: meters at REAL-WORLD scale. The game builds the whole house (and the bowling alley) at scale 1.25 so a 2.1 m upright bear clears doorways and the third-person camera has room.
Axes: x runs west -> east, z runs north -> south (front of house = north = z 0). Each room is a rectangle: x, z = north-west corner; w = size along x; d = size along z.
Doors: x, z is the door's center point on the shared wall. Types: hinged, french (pair of glass doors), sliding, opening (no door, cased opening), garage (overhead), exterior.
Photos: every room lists the reference photo(s) in reference/house-photos/ to copy materials, furniture and lighting from.

rooms.name: Basement TV den
rooms.notes: Exposed pine beams, cream walls, beige carpet. Tufted leather Chesterfield sofa, brown leather recliner, TV on a wood stand (shows the rotating TV images), side table with globe, nautical chart on wall, pine armoire. French doors on the south wall open straight onto the lawn (walkout). Basement stairs arrive in its west end.

rooms.name: Utility room
rooms.notes: Closed door only, not enterable (saves work).

rooms.name: Bowling lounge
rooms.notes: Seating, ball rack, view of both lanes, overhead score screens visible. Open to the alley along its north side.

rooms.name: Bowling alley (2 lanes)
rooms.notes: Two side-by-side lanes running WEST -> EAST: bowler stands at the west end, pins at the east end. Regulation proportions before the 1.25 game scale: 4.6 m approach, 18.29 m foul line to head pin, ~4 m pin deck + pit + machine. Ball return between the lanes. Extends ~16 m past the house footprint underground; nobody can see that from outside.

stairs.notes: Starts in the back hall off the kitchen, lands in the den.

rooms.name: 2-car garage
rooms.notes: Concrete floor, white walls. Two overhead doors on the WEST wall facing the driveway. This is how everyone walks in.

rooms.name: Back entry / mudroom
rooms.notes: Terracotta tile, braided red rug, exposed pine beams, speckled plaster walls, double pine closet doors, black spindle bench, firewood rack, exterior door with window on the north wall.

rooms.name: Half bath
rooms.notes: On your RIGHT as you walk in from the garage. Toilet, vanity, mirror.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.notes: Straight ahead from the garage door. Knotty pine cabinets and island with double sink, pine counters, black electric range, stainless fridge, hanging copper/steel pot rack, exposed timber-beam ceiling with spotlights, terracotta tile floor, braided rugs, microwave, toaster, kettle.

rooms.name: Back hall + basement stairs
rooms.notes: Short hall behind the kitchen holding the stairs down to the basement.

rooms.name: Dining hall (casual)
rooms.notes: On the LEFT after the kitchen. Wood farmhouse table with 4 slat-back chairs, blue braided rug, brass ceiling fan, beige speckled wallpaper, framed print, flowers on a white plant stand.

rooms.name: Common area (pink sitting room)
rooms.notes: Pink walls, bold floral swag curtains, cream sofa with sheepskin throw, cream leather armchair + ottoman, side tables, framed pictures, floor lamp. Door to the deck/patio on the south wall. Andrew confirmed (2026-10-11): this is the little common area.

rooms.name: Living room (great room)
rooms.notes: Sunken 3 steps (0.5 m) below the foyer. Two-story cathedral ceiling (peak ~7 m). South wall: two big half-round arched windows over a row of transom windows over glass doors to the deck. East wall: floor-to-ceiling red brick fireplace with white mantel (fire lit at night). Upstairs balcony overlooks it along the north side. Cream carpet, grand piano, harp, striped wingback chairs, blue camelback sofas, glass coffee tables, Tiffany-style floor lamp, oil paintings.

rooms.name: Office / library (under the stairs)
rooms.notes: Under the stairs/balcony. Glass French doors into the great room. Floor-to-ceiling built-in pine bookshelves full of books, burgundy patterned carpet, navy walls with a floral border, beige armchair + ottoman, plaid curtains.

rooms.name: Front hall / foyer + main stairs
rooms.notes: Front door (with sidelights) on the north wall to the porch. Honey oak floor, oriental rug, pendant lantern, console table. Main staircase (oak handrail, white balusters) rises to the upstairs landing. Steps down into the great room.

rooms.name: Formal dining room - CATAN ROOM
rooms.notes: Tan walls, brass candle chandelier, mahogany china cabinet, cream tie-back curtains, oriental rug. Mahogany table set for EXACTLY 4 chairs - this is where Catan is played.

rooms.name: Downstairs bedroom (blue)
rooms.notes: Blue-gray walls and carpet, floral curtains on two windows, black drop-leaf desk with lamp and mirror, queen bed with white comforter, framed prints.

outdoor_attached.name: Farmer's porch
outdoor_attached.notes: Covered porch with white square columns across the front of the east block. Front steps down to the lawn.

outdoor_attached.name: Greenhouse
outdoor_attached.notes: Curved-eave glass greenhouse with white aluminum frame, attached to the back of the garage wing. Contents: see GAME_SPEC greenhouse section.

outdoor_attached.name: Deck
outdoor_attached.notes: Gray boards, simple post-and-rail railing, green market umbrella over a round black wrought-iron table with 4 chairs. Elevated ~2 m above the back lawn (the ground drops toward the south), with stairs down to the lawn on the west end. The great room bumps out into it.

doors.notes: 3 steps down into the great room

stairs.direction: rises from the foyer to the upstairs landing (L-shape is fine)
down from the deck's west end to the back lawn

rooms.name: Landing
rooms.notes: Top of the main stairs, open to the foyer below with an oak-and-white railing. Brass lantern chandelier, gilt mirror, dark curio cabinet, plant on a white table.

rooms.name: Balcony hallway
rooms.notes: West part (x 17-21.5) is a normal hall. East part (x 21.5-29.5) is the balcony hanging over the great room: oak-and-white railing on its south edge, looks out the arched windows.

rooms.name: Upstairs bathroom
rooms.notes: White swirl wallpaper, blue-green geometric border, white vanity with tiled top, big mirror, curvy vanity light bar, double-hung window with a roman shade, tub/shower.

rooms.name: Skylight bedroom
rooms.notes: Sloped attic ceiling with a skylight, orange wainscot with a patterned border, papasan chair, white daybed, closet.

rooms.name: Pink bedroom
rooms.notes: Pink walls, teal-blue carpet, black four-poster bed with floral quilt, two sets of white double closet doors, abstract purple painting, lamp on a nightstand.

rooms.name: Yellow bedroom
rooms.notes: Pale yellow walls, sloped dormer ceiling and knee walls, twin bed with yellow comforter, bookcases full of books, cream dresser/hutch with books, school pennant, sunflowers.

open_to_below.notes: Two-story great room, no floor here.
